item.title: Amazon strategised about keeping water use secret
item.description:
📝 4 trillion corporation defends its approach to water usage and has taken steps to improve water efficiency. But while Microsoft and Google regularly publish their water consumption, Amazon has never publicly disclosed how much water its giant server farms consume. The Water Positive campaign only applies to AWS.
🔗 Read more: https://www.source-material.org/amazon-leak-reveals-true-data-centres-water-usage-secret-plan/

item.title: Microsoft in court for allegedly misleading Australians over 365 subscriptions
item.description:
📝 The ACCC alleges that since 31 October 2024, Microsoft has told subscribers of Microsoft 365 Personal and Family plans with auto-renewal enabled that to maintain their subscription they must accept the integration of Copilot and pay higher prices for their plan, or, alternatively, cancel their subscription. The annual subscription price for the Microsoft 365 Family plan increased by 29 per cent from $139 to $179. The ACCC is seeking consumer redress in this case for Microsoft 365 Personal and Family subscribers affected by the alleged conduct.
🔗 Read more: https://www.accc.gov.au/media-release/microsoft-in-court-for-allegedly-misleading-millions-of-australians-over-microsoft-365-subscriptions
